title: Task-specific knowledge distillation from the vision foundation model for enhanced medical image segmentation
mechanism: Fine-tune a VFM on the target task, then distil it into a small segmentation network.
adaptation: Only if a VFM-H arm helps E1: distil it into house U-Net++ R34 with soft labels on 478 labelled + 11.9k pool cells, keeping the cheap model for deployment and ensembles.
min_experiment: Arm: R34 student distilled from the best VFM-H arm. Baseline: house PF. Metric: E1 crack relF1@2 and inactive IoU, clean-49 crack IoU. Kill: student keeps less than half of the teacher's E1 gain.
evidence: R: abstract fragment; medical segmentation with limited target data; numbers not read.
prior_overlap: none: distillation is listed as never tried.
